title: Quiet Stage A image after the NAT-093 run (inconclusive, so not a dependency): NAT-092's image with the com.apple.lsd job removed from the small root (md0), because lsd's repeated CPU-monitor kernel message filled the 32 KiB log tail; image name loader-diag-xnu-sq-md1, tag NAT096-sq1; build, package, derive the driver, tests incl. byte-for-byte comparison with NAT-092's build, mutation pass, decision draft
acceptance: The small root is NAT-089's Stage A recipe with one more --skip-job (com.apple.lsd): the LaunchDaemons directory holds 18 Apple plists plus com.nat085.ps.plist and no lsd plist, and every other file of md0 equals NAT-092's md0 file for file (sha256 per file recorded). The built payload equals NAT-092's except the md0 region and the command-line tag (NAT092-sb1 -> NAT096-sq1); the loader image differs only in the words that encode the image name; packaged RECOVERY and payload hashes are recorded.

A session driver derived from NAT-092's by counted substitutions (derive96.py --check) with the registry gate NAT-089, NAT-092, NAT-096 and, if NAT-097 is done before the run, NAT-097; tests, a mutation pass under the RAM cap, and a decision draft with every hash recomputed that states what the image changes against NAT-092 (one job removed), why (NAT-093's flood), what is expected and the rows that decide. Nothing here measures the phone.
steps: Build the small root and the image
